title: Vegetable omelette with pepper and spinach
steps: Finely dice the pepper and slice the spring onion.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan, fry the pepper for 3 minutes, then briefly wilt the spinach and spring onion.
Pour over the eggs, cook over medium heat for 3–4 minutes until set, grate the cheese over, fold the omelette and serve.
